parameters.content:
## Workflow B - one personal briefing per listener (needs Workflow A to have filled lb_stories / lb_articles)
**Input:** form with free text and/or a demo preset. **Output:** downloadable HTML page (audio player, transcript with a source link per fact, *why you got this briefing*, cost).
1. *Build profile* -> keyword rules (or the LLM parser, `USE_LLM_PROFILE_PARSER`) turn the text into a fixed profile and record WHY.
2. *Build planner request* filters today's stories (news window, no advice, text available); *OpenAI planner* (gpt-6.2-sol) interprets the listener and plans the briefing (wishes, stories, roles, word budgets, reserves); *Select stories* enforces integrity only (stories exist, picks included, length fits) - rules ranking as fallback.
3. Claims are extracted only for planned + reserve stories not cached in `lb_claims`.
4. *Material check* fits the plan to the verified facts (no padding, reserves for thin stories); *OpenAI script writer* (gpt-6.1-terra) tells it from verified claims only; *Check script* + *OpenAI script verifier* check AND repair sentences; *Build script & gate* adds greeting/sign-off by code, fills short scripts with verified quick hits, blocks on unsupported numbers/advice, splits the audio into parts.
Open the result: *Package briefing page* -> Binary -> briefing_page -> Download.
